_comment: Example county bundle for Davidson County, Tennessee, which the build spec used
as its placeholder. Replace with your real target counties.
IMPORTANT: these endpoints were identified from public documentation but the
field names were not verifiable when this was written. Run 'gf discover <name>'
on each one first. The field mapper resolves columns at runtime and prints its
confidence, so a schema surprise shows up as a low confidence guess rather than

sources.name: davidson-parcels
sources.label: Davidson County ownership parcels
notes: This is the backbone. Owner name, owner mailing address, last sale date and
last sale amount all come from here, and those four columns are what produce
the absentee, tenure and equity signals.
Disabled by default because a full county pull is roughly a few hundred
requests. Enable it deliberately, ideally with a where clause that narrows to
your buy box, then let the nightly runs keep it fresh.
Be polite: minIntervalMs is set to 400 because this is a county server.

sources.name: davidson-codes-violations
sources.label: Nashville property standards violations
notes: Code enforcement is the most underrated free distress signal. An owner who
will not cut the grass or fix the roof is an owner with a problem.
Confirm the eventTypeFrom field name with 'gf discover davidson-codes-violations',
then adjust the map keys to the values that dataset actually uses.
